# Your Daily Briefing — 5 September 2026

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training session logged and 7,614 steps, which is solid base movement. You burned 2,397 kcal, nudging just above your 2,300 target, so the day balanced out well from an energy perspective. The main flag is sleep at just 5.8 hours — that's one to address.

Your HRV at 98ms sits just below your 100–119ms baseline, and with the short sleep, your body is telling you it's working to recover. The good news is your resting HR of 47bpm and stress score of 30 both look excellent — so you're not in a hole, just slightly under-recovered. Keep today's session as planned but avoid pushing into red-zone effort.

Prioritise sleep tonight above everything else — even perfect nutrition won't offset chronic short sleep for weight loss and training adaptation. Aim for 7.5 hours minimum.
